description: 7枚羽根の床置き扇風機。実厚の開いたガード、ピッチ付き羽根、支柱、首振りつまみと台座。 全体寸法は約34.6×32.8×82.8cm。部品別に編集できる静的モデル。通電・加熱・送風は再現していません。
mechanism: Fixed-height static generic fan. Rotor parts separately editable; clearance must accommodate full rotation. Tilt and oscillation represented mechanically but not rigged. Spiral grille generalized to radial wires; cable beyond strain relief omitted.
review_status: Independent geometry, full canonical photography and exact source package gates passed

independent_review.scope: Independent saved geometry, canonical photography and exact source package acceptance. Static visual diorama appliances; no electrical machinery, heating/airflow simulation or safety certification.
